checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Two separate square images, not a collage
must.why: Bottle-on-white and lake scene are separate 640x640 images. A blank white intermediate also exists but was not delivered.

must.item: First image keeps bottle silhouette, matte black finish, lid details on plain white
must.why: The bottle is the original cutout with matching lid, ring and matte finish on near-white.

must.item: No wooden table or original background in first image
must.why: Table and room are gone. Only a faint grey tint is left near the edges.

must.item: Second image realistically shows same bottle upright on rock beside mountain lake with sunrise lighting
must.why: A black bottle stands on a rock by a lake with mountains and warm golden sunrise light. The lid is a little different from the original.

must.item: No added text or logos in either image
must.why: No text or logos are visible in either image.

faults.what: Lake-scene bottle is regenerated: the lid and handle loop differ slightly from the original and the body proportions are slightly altered.
White background has slight grey gradient and the bottle floats without a shadow or ground contact.
Some cutout edge softness and a slightly grey background tint on the first image.

summary: Both requested square images came out well: a clean cutout of the real bottle on near-white and a realistic sunrise lake scene. The only issues are minor bottle detail drift in the lake image and a slightly grey white background.
